ja.title: CytoVIでバッチ差を消すと残したい差はどうなるか
ja.summary: 健康骨髄の公開測定に既知のバッチ差を加え、交差した設計と完全交絡を比較する。CytoVIの保存出力から、粗い細胞型の読出しと同一型内の参照差を別々に診断する。
ja.seo_title: CytoVIでバッチ差を消すと残したい差はどうなるか

en.title: What should batch correction preserve? A design diagnostic with CytoVI
en.summary: A semi-synthetic experiment on public measurements from two healthy bone-marrow donors contrasts crossed and confounded artificial batches. Fixed CytoVI runs separate coarse cell-label readability from within-type reference contrasts; this is not a disease-preservation validation.
en.seo_title: CytoVI batch correction and within-type differences
en.seo_description: A two-donor semi-synthetic experiment separates coarse cell labels, within-type reference contrasts and batch removal under confounding.
